params.initialSupply: Supply in whole tokens. The constructor scales it by        the token's 18 decimals, so passing 1000 mints 1000.000000000000000000.
params.name_: Display name of the token, e.g. "Workshop Token".

userdoc.notice: A minimal ERC-20 token used in the Avalanche Academy "Deploy Your First         Contract" workshop. The deployer picks the name, symbol and initial         supply, and receives the entire supply at deployment.         Every function is written out in full rather than inherited, so a         workshop attendee can read the whole token in a single screen. For a         production token, use a reviewed implementation such as OpenZeppelin's         ERC20 instead of this one.
